description:
This protocol performs a custom mass spec sample prep for up to 20 samples.



Opentrons temperature module with NEST 96-well PCR plate 100µl full skirt
4x6 aluminum block for NEST 1.5ml snapcap tubes
Opentrons 20µl tiprack
Opentrons 300µl tiprack
Opentrons P20 and P300 GEN2 single-channel electronic pipette



4x6 aluminum block for NEST 1.5ml snapcap tubes (slot 2)
 tube D1: denaturing solution
 tube D2: DTT
* all other tubes: samples that will be transferred to their corresponding locations in sample plate

labware.name: Opentrons 96 Well Aluminum Block with NEST Well Plate 100 µL on Temperature Module GEN1 on 1
